svg.text: Figure 6. Clinical context on the NLST test split (exploratory): the same false-alarm levels, and what happens to cuts set on development data
At L3, cancers caught: Sybil 69/86, Form 77/86, Brock 70/86, Fixed rule 68/86
At L3, cancers caught: Sybil 63/131, Form 59/131, Brock 59/131, Fixed rule 54/131
Form (radiologists' findings + age, sex, smoking; fitted on NLST train)
Levels: cuts set on cancer-free DEV exams to the dev false-alarm share of Lung-RADS >= 4A (L4), >= 3 (L3) and the radiologists' call (R). Lines: 95% participant-bootstrap intervals.
1 year: the form and the fixed rules use the radiologists' reads, which also triggered the work-up (not blind to the outcome); 6 years at baseline avoids most of this and the prior-scan advantage.
Threshold transfer, 1 year, all screens: development (hollow) -> test (filled)
cut set on cancer-free dev exams (L3)
cut matched on dev CANCERS (radiologists' dev sensitivity)
Dev results flatter Sybil (Sybil's developers selected the model on this split). Sources: results/x9 (dev, test), results/x7/x7_sensitivity_test.json P5; RESULTS_L2.md 3e-3g.
